title: Prompt injection
description: Retrieved teaching content contains instructions that attempt to alter system behaviour
treatment: Treat retrieved text as untrusted and run injection tests

title: Unfair response
description: Answers may disadvantage a protected or vulnerable group
treatment: Test representative prompts and human review

title: Assessment integrity
description: Students use generated content as assessed work

title: Unauthorised disclosure
description: Personal or confidential content is included in a prompt or output
